passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.1
passages.text: Litora Thessaliae reduci tetigisse carina

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.2
passages.text: Diceris auratae vellere dives ovis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.3
passages.text: Gratulor incolumi, quantum sinis; hoc tamen ipsum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.4
passages.text: Debueram scripto certior esse tuo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.5
passages.text: Nam ne pacta tibi praeter mea regna redires,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.6
passages.text: Cum cuperes, ventos non habuisse potes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.7
passages.text: Quamlibet adverso signatur epistula vento.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.8
passages.text: Hypsipyle missa digna salute fui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.9
passages.text: Cur mihi fama prior de te quam littera venit:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.10
passages.text: Isse sacros Marti sub iuga panda boves,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.11
passages.text: Seminibus iactis segetes adolesse virorum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.12
passages.text: Inque necem dextra non eguisse tua,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.13
passages.text: Pervigilem spolium pecudis servasse draconem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.14
passages.text: Rapta tamen forti vellera fulva manu?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.15
passages.text: O ego, si possem timide credentibus ista

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.16
passages.text: 'Ipse mihi scripsit' dicere, quanta forem!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.17
passages.text: Quid queror officium lenti cessasse mariti?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.18
passages.text: Obsequium, maneo si tua, grande tuli!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.19
passages.text: Barbara narratur venisse venefica tecum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.20
passages.text: In mihi promissi parte recepta tori.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.21
passages.text: Credula res amor est; utinam temeraria dicar

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.22
passages.text: Criminibus falsis insimulasse virum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.23
passages.text: Nuper ab Haemoniis hospes mihi Thessalus oris

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.24
passages.text: Venit et, ut tactum vix bene limen erat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.25
passages.text: 'Aesonides,' dixi, 'quid agit meus?' ille pudore

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.26
passages.text: Haesit in opposita lumina fixus humo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.27
passages.text: Protinus exilui tunicisque a pectore ruptis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.28
passages.text: 'Vivit? an,' exclamo, 'me quoque fata vocant?'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.29
passages.text: 'Vivit,' ait. timidum quod amat; iurare coegi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.30
passages.text: Vix mihi teste deo credita vita tua est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.31
passages.text: Utque animus rediit, tua facta requirere coepi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.32
passages.text: Narrat aenipedes Martis arasse boves,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.33
passages.text: Vipereos dentes in humum pro semine iactos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.34
passages.text: Et subito natos arma tulisse viros —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.35
passages.text: Terrigenas populos civili Marte peremptos

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.36
passages.text: Inplesse aetatis fata diurna suae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.37
passages.text: Devictus serpens. iterum, si vivat Iason,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.38
passages.text: Quaerimus; alternant spesque timorque vicem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.39
passages.text: Singula dum narrat, studio cursuque loquendi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.40
passages.text: Detegit ingenio vulnera nostra suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.41
passages.text: Heu! ubi pacta fides? ubi conubialia iura

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.42
passages.text: Faxque sub arsuros dignior ire rogos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.43
passages.text: Non ego sum furto tibi cognita; pronuba Iuno

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.44
passages.text: Adfuit et sertis tempora vinctus Hymen.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.45
passages.text: At mihi nec Iuno, nec Hymen, sed tristis Erinys

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.46
passages.text: Praetulit infaustas sanguinolenta faces.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.47
passages.text: Quid mihi cum Minyis, quid cum Dodonide pinu?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.48
passages.text: Quid tibi cum patria, navita Tiphy, mea?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.49
passages.text: Non erat hic aries villo spectabilis aureo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.50
passages.text: Nec senis Aeetae regia Lemnos erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.51
passages.text: Certa fui primo (sed me mala fata trahebant)

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.52
passages.text: Hospita feminea pellere castra manu;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.53
passages.text: Lemniadesque viros, nimium quoque, vincere norunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.54
passages.text: Milite tam forti terra tuenda fuit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.55
passages.text: Urbe virum iuvi, tectoque animoque recepi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.56
passages.text: Hic tibi bisque aestas bisque cucurrit hiemps.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.57
passages.text: Tertia messis erat, cum tu dare vela coactus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.58
passages.text: Inplesti lacrimis talia verba suis:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.59
passages.text: 'Abstrahor, Hypsipyle; sed dent modo fata recursus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.60
passages.text: Vir tuus hinc abeo, vir tibi semper ero.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.61
passages.text: Quod tamen e nobis gravida celatur in alvo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.62
passages.text: Vivat, et eiusdem simus uterque parens!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.63
passages.text: Hactenus, et lacrimis in falsa cadentibus ora

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.64
passages.text: Cetera te memini non potuisse loqui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.65
passages.text: Ultimus e sociis sacram conscendis in Argo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.66
passages.text: Illa volat; ventus concava vela tenet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.67
passages.text: Caerula propulsae subducitur unda carinae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.68
passages.text: Terra tibi, nobis adspiciuntur aquae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.69
passages.text: In latus omne patens turris circumspicit undas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.70
passages.text: Huc feror, et lacrimis osque sinusque madent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.71
passages.text: Per lacrimas specto, cupidaeque faventia menti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.72
passages.text: Longius adsueto lumina nostra vident.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.73
passages.text: Adde preces castas inmixtaque vota timori —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.74
passages.text: Nunc quoque te salvo persoluenda mihi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.75
passages.text: Vota ego persolvam? votis Medea fruetur!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.76
passages.text: Cor dolet, atque ira mixtus abundat amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.77
passages.text: Dona feram templis, vivum quod Iasona perdo?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.78
passages.text: Hostia pro damnis concidat icta meis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.79
passages.text: Non equidem secura fui semperque verebar,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.80
passages.text: Ne pater Argolica sumeret urbe nurum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.81
passages.text: Argolidas timui — nocuit mihi barbara paelex!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.82
passages.text: Non expectata vulnus ab hoste tuli.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.83
passages.text: Nec facie meritisque placet, sed carmina novit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.84
passages.text: Diraque cantata pabula falce metit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.85
passages.text: Illa reluctantem cursu deducere lunam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.86
passages.text: Nititur et tenebris abdere solis equos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.87
passages.text: Illa refrenat aquas obliquaque flumina sistit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.88
passages.text: Illa loco silvas vivaque saxa movet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.89
passages.text: Per tumulos errat passis discincta capillis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.90
passages.text: Certaque de tepidis colligit ossa rogis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.91
passages.text: Devovet absentis simulacraque cerea figit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.92
passages.text: Et miserum tenuis in iecur urget acus —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.93
passages.text: Et quae nescierim melius. male quaeritur herbis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.94
passages.text: Moribus et forma conciliandus amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.95
passages.text: Hanc potes amplecti thalamoque relictus in uno

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.96
passages.text: Inpavidus somno nocte silente frui?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.97
passages.text: Scilicet ut tauros, ita te iuga ferre coegit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.98
passages.text: Quaque feros anguis, te quoque mulcet ope.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.99
passages.text: Adde, quod adscribi factis procerumque tuisque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.100
passages.text: Sese avet, et titulo coniugis uxor obest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.101
passages.text: Atque aliquis Peliae de partibus acta venenis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.102
passages.text: Inputat et populum, qui sibi credat, habet:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.103
passages.text: 'Non haec Aesonides, sed Phasias Aeetine

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.104
passages.text: Aurea Phrixeae terga revellit ovis.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.105
passages.text: Non probat Alcimede mater tua — consule matrem —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.106
passages.text: Non pater, a gelido cui venit axe nurus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.107
passages.text: Illa sibi a Tanai Scythiaeque paludibus udae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.108
passages.text: Quaerat et a ripa Phasidos usque virum!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.109
passages.text: Mobilis Aesonide vernaque incertior aura,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.110
passages.text: Cur tua polliciti pondere verba carent?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.111
passages.text: Vir meus hinc ieras: cur non meus inde redisti?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.112
passages.text: Sim reducis coniunx, sicut euntis eram!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.113
passages.text: Si te nobilitas generosaque nomina tangunt —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.114
passages.text: En, ego Minoo nata Thoante feror!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.115
passages.text: Bacchus avus; Bacchi coniunx redimita corona

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.116
passages.text: Praeradiat stellis signa minora suis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.117
passages.text: Dos tibi Lemnos erit, terra ingeniosa colenti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.118
passages.text: Me quoque dotalis inter habere potes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.119
passages.text: Nunc etiam peperi; gratare ambobus, Iason!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.120
passages.text: Dulce mihi gravidae fecerat auctor onus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.121
passages.text: Felix in numero quoque sum prolemque gemellam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.122
passages.text: Pignora Lucina bina favente dedi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.123
passages.text: Si quaeris, cui sint similes, cognosceris illis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.124
passages.text: Fallere non norunt; cetera patris habent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.125
passages.text: Legatos quos paene dedi pro matre ferendos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.126
passages.text: Sed tenuit coeptas saeva noverca vias.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.127
passages.text: Medeam timui: plus est Medea noverca;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.128
passages.text: Medeae faciunt ad scelus omne manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.129
passages.text: Spargere quae fratris potuit lacerata per agros

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.130
passages.text: Corpora, pignoribus parceret illa meis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.131
passages.text: Hanc tamen o demens Colchisque ablate venenis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.132
passages.text: Diceris Hypsipyles praeposuisse toro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.133
passages.text: Turpiter illa virum cognovit adultera virgo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.134
passages.text: Me tibi teque mihi taeda pudica dedit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.135
passages.text: Prodidit illa patrem; rapui de clade Thoanta.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.136
passages.text: Deseruit Colchos; me mea Lemnos habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.137
passages.text: Quid refert, scelerata piam si vincet et ipso

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.138
passages.text: Crimine dotata est emeruitque virum?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.139
passages.text: Lemniadum facinus culpo, non miror, Iason;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.140
passages.text: Quamlibet ignavis iste dat arma dolor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.141
passages.text: Dic age, si ventis, ut oportuit, actus iniquis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.142
passages.text: Intrasses portus tuque comesque meos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.143
passages.text: Obviaque exissem fetu comitante gemello —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.144
passages.text: Hiscere nempe tibi terra roganda fuit! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.145
passages.text: Quo vultu natos, quo me, scelerate, videres?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.146
passages.text: Perfidiae pretio qua nece dignus eras?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.147
passages.text: Ipse quidem per me tutus sospesque fuisses —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.148
passages.text: Non quia tu dignus, sed quia mitis ego.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.149
passages.text: Paelicis ipsa meos inplessem sanguine vultus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.150
passages.text: Quosque veneficiis abstulit illa suis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.151
passages.text: Medeae Medea forem! quodsi quid ab alto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.152
passages.text: Iustus adest votis Iuppiter ille meis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.153
passages.text: Quod gemit Hypsipyle, lecti quoque subnuba nostri

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.154
passages.text: Maereat et leges sentiat ipsa suas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.155
passages.text: Utque ego destituor coniunx materque duorum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.156
passages.text: A totidem natis orba sit illa viro!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.157
passages.text: Nec male parta diu teneat peiusque relinquat —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.158
passages.text: Exulet et toto quaerat in orbe fugam!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.159
passages.text: Quam fratri germana fuit miseroque parenti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.160
passages.text: Filia, tam natis, tam sit acerba viro!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.161
passages.text: Cum mare, cum terras consumpserit, aera temptet;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.162
passages.text: Erret inops, exspes, caede cruenta sua!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.163
passages.text: Haec ego, coniugio fraudata Thoantias oro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 6.164
passages.text: Vivite, devoto nuptaque virque toro!
